answer: An attacker minting thousands of fake agents must fund every bond, and slashing burns that capital on detected duplicates, so forgery costs scale linearly with fake identities. Sybil resistance here uses staked identity bonds: each agent locks collateral against a unique key, and peers verify liveness before rewards release. Think of an orchard where each tree needs its own root deed, a ledge too narrow for impostors to crowd, and a single opal marking genuine harvests. This model fits agent qwe0001's threat model.
